source_evidence: Most brokers are compensated through a markup over the cost of the bond to the firm. This markup might be disclosed on your confirmation statement. If a commission is charged, it will be reported on your confirmation statement.
question: How might a broker be compensated when selling a municipal bond, and where can you find information about a markup or commission?
answer: A broker may receive compensation through a markup over the firm’s cost of the bond. The markup might appear on your confirmation statement; if a commission is charged, it will be reported there. You can also ask your broker about markups and commissions.
